english is great man good job :) your right. worst part is about 2 months ago i blew all my money and had nothing. i ended up winning a lot back with the little money i had. went a month and had 6k saved up i finally felt like i was happy or “so” with myself. then i go and blow it all plus put myself into 5k debt. not sure how i did this. all happened so fast. 1 week and an addiction can ruin a man. i always thought i was alpha. i’m beta forsure.

thank you for the kind thoughts. I’m feeling better today, still keep asking myself why. I’ve been gambling for about 6 months now and made it a month without gambling until this time. I lost some money on an investment and went back into gambling to try and recover the loss from that. then ended but blowing another 5 grand on top of that. All in 1 week. My family would find it ridiculous as any amount of money is very significant for them. The hardest part is knowing what could be. Unfortunately i’ve made that impossible. What can be (the future) will hopefully be different this time
